card.name: Hyper- and Hypo- starting medical terms
card.fires_on: The opening piece "Hyper" or "Hyp" of long medical terms such as hypercorticism, hyperglycemia and hypoxanthine, mostly right after a section number in warnings headings.

modes.label: Hypercorticism heading
modes.description: "Hyper" starting the warning heading Hypercorticism and Adrenal Suppression after a section number.

modes.label: Other hyper/hypo terms
modes.description: "Hyper" or "Hyp" opening words like hyperglycemia or hypoxanthine.
modes.example: Any patient treated with atypical antipsychotics should be monitored for symptoms of<< hyper>>glycemia including polydipsia

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward continuing with letters starting with D, though the output effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires on the start of long medical words beginning with hyper- or hypo-, especially in the Hypercorticism warning heading.
